==Description==
'''PVP_10''' was a test [[Maps|map]] for [[PVP Test]].

==Design & Path==
'''PVP_10''' was a map split into two parts. These parts were identical, except one was colored red while the other was blue, and the sides were flipped. It was a basic baseplate with multiple cliffs on it, though none of them actually counted as cliff spots. There were three bricks next to the path. 

The path starts at one edge of the map and ends at the other. It has a short straight path before taking a right turn, which leads to a long straight path. That path then takes a left turn leading to a short straight path and the exit.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:PVP 10}}

==Strategy==
*The first edge of the map is an optimal spot for towers such as the [[Brawler]] and [[Gladiator]], as they can make use of most of their range.
**Cliff towers like the [[Ranger]] and [[Mortar]] will cover the whole map, making them very useful choices for this map.
*[[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] should be placed to cover both cliff and optimal ground spaces, including both edges of the map.
*Due to most of the path being a straight line, [[Ace Pilot]]'s Figure8 flight path is the most optimal choice for it.

==Trivia==
*The intermission lobby lists SorenDerg as one of the creators. However, they were not actually involved in creating this map and have not even been active in the Tower Defense Simulator community since early 2023.
